result.detail: No tool runs are reported, because none happened in this seat. Three parts of the testbench were chosen for portability. It has no `timescale, which avoids Verilator's TIMESCALEMOD mismatch with the RTL. It does not index arrays with integer variables. Its literals are sized, to avoid Verilator's default-fatal WIDTH warnings. Under Verilator, the first $error may stop the run before the verdict line, which still counts as a failed run. A follow-up task should add the formal_spec (.sby, prove mode, no [tasks], listing axi4_lite_regs.v) and the failure-path testbench named in microarchitecture section 7.
